关系边明确显示满足与排除的适配约束；排序另由参考票数决定。: Edges show satisfied and rejected compatibility constraints; reference votes determine the ranking separately.
采样坐标为示意位置，颜色表示第一观测指标；不代表真实地理坐标。: Sample positions are illustrative and colors show the first observed indicator; these are not real geographical coordinates.
当前样本图像参与实际特征计算，切换观测可查看不同形态。: The current image supplies actual computed features; select another observation to inspect a different shape.
以下资料用于专业概念和方法依据；实验观测均独立合成。: These sources support business concepts and methods; all experimental observations are independently synthesized.
当前窗口的离散功率谱: Discrete power spectrum of the current window
从当前观测计算的功率谱: Power spectrum computed from the current observation
实际去均值DFT功率；频点索引不等于现场仪器Hz。: Actual demeaned DFT power; bin indices are not field instrument frequencies in Hz.
各输出独立拟合，约束说明与投影前贡献见本例方法讲解。: Outputs are fitted separately; see the method explanation for constraints and pre-projection contributions.
参考样本学习二次项与交互系数；独立校准记录不参与拟合。: Reference samples fit quadratic and interaction coefficients; calibration records do not enter fitting.
贡献和为约束投影前的预测；界面另列最终非负、单调或比例约束结果。: Contributions sum to the pre-projection prediction. Final nonnegative, ordered or fractional outputs are listed separately.
偏置加当前多项式贡献得到预测；系数来自参考集，关联不等于因果。: Bias plus polynomial contributions gives the prediction. Coefficients come from references; association is not causation.
参考观测特征经过标准化；预测票数与近邻距离由实际检索得到。: Reference features are standardized. Votes and neighbor distances come from actual retrieval.
先过滤不满足适配条件的候选，再按参考近邻票数排序。: Filter incompatible candidates, then rank by reference-neighbor votes.
输入特征来自当前波形、图形或观测指标；标准化和邻居标签仅来自参考集。: Features come from the current signal, shape or observation. Standardization and neighbor labels come only from references.
正常参考样本估计中位数与1.4826倍MAD，阈值仅由参考分数分位数得到。: Normal references estimate medians and 1.4826-scaled MAD. Score quantiles from references alone determine thresholds.
各项稳健标准化残差平方相加形成分数；这是正常背景偏离，不是已确认事故。: Squared robust standardized residuals sum to the score. A background departure is not a confirmed incident.
参考波形特征训练像素分数；动态规划再最小化分数代价与层位跳跃惩罚。: Reference waveform features fit pixel scores. Dynamic programming minimizes score costs plus horizon-jump penalties.
贡献解释局部logit；最终路径还受相邻道连续性约束，不能把局部分数当最终路径。: Contributions explain local logits. The final path also depends on inter-trace continuity; local scores are not the final path.
